steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: He was a good superior, once.
The FAC soldier guarding the confinement cell lights a cigarette. The blue-grey smoke rises under the corridor lights.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Just a few months ago, he was a humorous and gentle friend, a respected role model, and an admirable team leader...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: And now?
Through the cell window, he takes a quick glance at the person inside, then hastily averts his gaze.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: In just a few months, Mania has messed up his brain and now he's spouting nonsense all day, heh...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: ...Poor madman.
The FAC soldier nips the cigarette butt spitefully and tosses it on the ground, as if taking it out on it.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Forget it. We all know we'll end up like that eventually, it's dumb to get sentimental...
A beep signals that a temporary key has been sent to your personal terminal.
The man steps aside, and you aim the key at the electronic lock on the door.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: ...Do me a favor.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: I know you're an anti-Mania expert, and you've saved many people... including Sinners who everyone has given up on...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Even if there's only a slight chance... please save him.
The confinement cell is dark, and you can only see a vague figure in the darkness.
Just as you're about to switch on the light, Rahu stops you.
She doesn't speak and only shakes her head. You understand what she means.
For someone who's used to the dark and has been through a lot of trauma, the sudden brightness will only irritate his fragile mind.
You walk over slowly. With the dim light from the corridor, you can make out the man in front of you.
You hear a score of strange and unnerving noises in the background. Thick, heavy panting. Rustling of fabric in tandem with breathing. A hum of surveillance devices.
There you find an astonishingly pale and gaunt face. His eyes are tightly shut, but his eyeballs are constantly moving. His expression is grotesque, as if he's having a terrifying dream.
Seemingly noticing your presence, he abruptly opens his eyes.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: ...Who are you?!

The man's pitch-black, hollow pupils seem like an abyss of resentment and hatred. His body lurches forward, straining the straitjacket. The tough synthetic fibers and fabric rub together to produce an unsettling rustle.

It's hard to imagine that a man with such a skeletal body could possess such terrifying strength, like a rabid beast. You have no doubt that had he not been restrained, he would have pounced at you the moment he opened his eyes and bitten your throat open.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Nice to meet you, Mr. Conrad Cage...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Rahu?!
The man ignores you and stares directly at the person accompanying you, uttering that name in a voice so harsh that it sounds like he's about to shatter his teeth.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Haha... Hahaha... How dare you come back?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: To pick up your bones.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Haha... You still remember that...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: And who is this?
The man's glance shifts to you, eyes filled with undisguised hostility and wariness.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I am ${PlayerName}, the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Rahu just got transferred to work at the MBCC. Think of me as her direct superior.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Yet another superior? Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Watch out, ${PlayerName}, that one bites.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...They weren't lying when they said Mania had screwed up your brain.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Yes, it's been so long, after all. Nothing surprises me anymore.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: It's only been a few months.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: A few months is a long time. Enough for me to turn into this ghost of a man, and for you to betray us and wag your tail at Paradeisos...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What exactly happened?
Rahu doesn't respond to the man's accusation and only presses him for his side of the story.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: What happened? Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: The same that happened in N.F. 103. Everyone died, right before my eyes and without reason. I was the only one lucky enough to have been salvaged like a piece of garbage...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: I'm beginning to understand what you felt back then, Rahu. I even thought you were the crazy one at the time. Turns out I just hadn't seen the truth yet.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Someone must pay for this... Paradeisos... will pay for this...
The man's voice is filled with spite and grudge and black veins are emerging on his face.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What exactly is this truth you're talking about?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Heh...
The man lets out a cold snort.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Why should I tell you?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Anyone, even Paradeisos, must be held accountable for their crimes. This is a rule I live by.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But there must be evidence that can prove all of this...
The man squints at you, then his gaze shifts to Rahu beside you. After a moment, he speaks.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Of course I've got evidence... Proof that Paradeisos killed Varna... and sent us on a suicide mission for nothing... West District, Inner Bay, DisSea, everything they've meddled in over these ten years...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: The question is: Why should I believe that you're not one of them?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Paradeisos has got plenty of lapdogs.
As he gives these answers, the man's gaze is fixed on Rahu, as if expecting her to react in some way.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Where's the evidence?
Rahu's voice is cold and her eyes are locked on Conrad. Before you can say anything, you feel an intimidating aura about her, warning you to shut up and back off.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Those are all false information, lies fabricated by the Underground to confuse people. You've been used. Hand it over to me, I'll handle it.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: FAC soldiers are obedient, disciplined, and dedicated to the battlefield. You are the most honorable and honest people who haven't seen true evil. You don't have the time to seek the truth and validate it.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: It doesn't matter who gave you this evidence, it's all fake. They're just using you to undermine Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Hand it over.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: ...That's all you have to say to me? Even now, you've got nothing else to tell me?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: To hell with the Underground! False information? You ever wonder who gave me this fake evidence? ...You did!

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: This is the evidence you collected yourself! You wanted this! The real Rahu wanted this! You went through hell for the truth, and listen to what you're saying now!

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: You're not Rahu. Who the hell are you?!
The man screams maniacally, breaking free from his restraints and lunging at you. His almost pitiful wails fill the air, bringing with it a wave of contamination.

Rahu pushes you aside and catches Conrad's flailing hands, pinning him to the ground. She mercilessly drives a Hypercube into his palm, brutally subduing this man driven to madness by grief. Her movements are swift, precise, and without hesitation.
Meanwhile, your shackles are subtly pulsating.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I am Rahu. I am the lucid one.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You're simply caught in the illusions of your past, lying to yourself. If you stay too far from the true reality, you'll only die trying to reach it.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Look ahead, Conrad, just like you once told me... Look ahead! Weren't you always the level-headed one?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: ...Look ahead?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Like a mad dog, your rage was satisfying, and it freed me from my hatred. I was only able to be level-headed because you vented the anger for all of us.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: And look at what you've become. How am I supposed to keep looking ahead?!
The man jerks his head up. Mania has eroded his sanity, allowing his deepest emotions to spill out uninhibitedly. His dark pupils are filled with despair and grudge.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: I shouldn't have let you go to that villa... I shouldn't have let you go alone... What happened there?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Was it Paradeisos? Or those assassins... What did they do to you? Why did you become like this...?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Where is Rahu... Where did my last comrade go...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><size=45>Did you kill her?!!!</size></color>
The man screams hysterically. The veins on his face twitch uncontrollably and dark scars appear on his pale skin. His emotional outburst is causing his Mania to flare up.
Rahu's Hypercube is almost pressed into his body and it's being rapidly depleted. Contamination keeps spilling out and starts to corrupt Rahu's body, her face showing crimson traces of Mania...

But she doesn't let go. Rahu holds her grip on Conrad firmly, staring intently into his eyes. You see intense emotions in her gaze. The shackles tremble violently. You can't tell whether it's from Conrad's Mania or Rahu's overflowing emotions, but now is not the time to get distracted.
You must react at once.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Rahu, step aside!

You impose a prohibition on her. In that instant, anger burns in her eyes. She looks as if she's about to pounce and bite at your neck just to protect that man. For the first time, you see the real her, and you make sure to remember this.

Then you try your best to subdue this furious Sinner, almost exhausting the power of the shackles to force her to step back. She must stay away from the contamination, and you must do what has to be done...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Hang in there, Conrad!

Conrad's Mania is on the verge of eruption, and you use all your strength to suppress it with the shackles. You've been warned by the medical department that compensating for those on the brink of Corruptor transformation is extremely dangerous, but this man cannot die.
Whether it's to save a good man's life, a ruined truth, or the Sinner behind you who's almost at her breaking point... Conrad cannot die. This much is clear to you.

The man finally opens his eyes. After the torment of Mania, his gaze is now confused, cloudy, and shattered. He glances at Rahu, then at you. Conrad slightly opens his mouth.
Finally, he speaks.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Again... Not enough... Just a little longer...
Squirming, he extends his hand to you.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Just a little longer...
The man's cloudy eyes turn to you but fail to focus.
His eyes remain closed, but he grips your hand tightly with surprising strength, his fingers stroking your palm as if cherishing this moment of tranquility and clarity.
But you quickly realize something is off. The rhythm of the man's fingers is too regular, as if he's conveying a short message to you...
Ornstein 47 301 Ornstein 47 301 Ornstein 47 301...
He repeats it over and over for fear that you don't understand his intention.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let him know you've taken note.

choices.text: Let him know you've taken note.

steps.content: You firmly grip the man's hand. He understands your meaning.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Haha... Get lost... All of you, get lost...
The man closes his eyes wearily, falling silent. But he's obviously still alive, his Mania temporarily stabilized.

You look at Rahu. Her emotions have been perfectly concealed. The knight in black silently stands behind you, watching the two of you without giving away any of her true feelings. Only the forgotten cold sweat on her forehead is proof of her fleeting true self.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: He's safe for now. Someone will take care of him. Let's go, we still have things to discuss.

She watches as you help Conrad onto the bed and cover him with a blanket. Wordlessly, she watches the man trapped in despair and pain fall into a deep sleep. Rahu simply closes her eyes for a moment, then looks at you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Yes, Commander.
Leaving the dim sickroom, you and Rahu are back on the other side of the door.
You nod to the guard and drag your still-exhausted body through the deserted corridor.
The corridor is empty and quiet save for your and Rahu's footsteps. Suddenly, you hear her icy voice from behind.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What did he give you?
As expected, she noticed Conrad's discreet gesture. She must also remember that soldier's secretive nature.
You make sure there's enough distance between you two and judge that you'll probably be able to use the shackles for self-defense, then turn around and spread your hands completely.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you interrogating me? Me, your Commander?

choices.text: Are you interrogating me? Me, your Commander?

steps.content: She doesn't avoid your gaze and her tone is emotionless.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No, but it's my duty to keep the Commander safe.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Conrad was reckless and flouted the taboo, and he ended up in this state. He's not a Sinner. Your shackles can't suppress the contamination in him. He's already become a huge threat to DisCity.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Are you asking me to banish him? Or kill him? You know I won't do that.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I know you won't. He's useful to you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Then heed my advice. Keep this confidential. Lock him up in the toughest prison cell you can find and post your best fighters to guard him around the clock. Otherwise, the people who provoked him will surely come knocking on your door.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: This is all... for your own safety.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Of course, I will do as you say.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: If you're so keen to protect him through me...

choices.text: If you're so keen to protect him through me...

steps.content: Rahu is momentarily taken aback, then her face hardens again. She opens her mouth to say something...
She is stumped by your remark. You watch her reaction with a grin and begin leisurely.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'll apply to the FAC to transfer him to the Bureau. Although he's not a Sinner, my power did work on him just now. We could use an extra observation subject.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: And I am indeed interested in him. I really want to know... what is it that he is fighting so desperately for all by himself.
You look at Rahu, who is staring back at you intensely. Having seen her true anger, you can now discern her emotions to some extent.

She is again suppressing her anger, probably grinding her teeth under her mask, doing a pretty good job at holding it in. It makes you want to poke at her again, maybe she will blurt out a heartfelt remark or two.
But the next second, she closes her eyes and takes a few slow breaths. When she opens them again, Rahu has regained her composure.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You misunderstood. The only one I must protect is my Commander.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: As you just said, he's been wrecked by Mania and his mind is in tatters. You're taking him in as an experimental subject to test your shackles' power. This is an acceptable reason. Anything beyond that, keep it to yourself.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No matter what he's passed onto you, no matter what interest you have in his ramblings. Those are very dangerous things.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The danger lies not in their value, but in your desire to cross the line. I will handle these dangerous matters myself, including all who attempt to touch them.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Next is my advice to you: Don't overreach yourself. Don't pry into things you shouldn't. Forget whatever he just told you. Otherwise, you will end up like him.
Once again, her tone is threatening. You look at her and pose your question slowly.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Is this a warning from your real master?

choices.text: Is this a warning from your real master?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Or are you protecting me like you protect Conrad?
It's the same old trick of yours, but she doesn't waver like she did a few seconds ago. She just looks at you stiffly like a statue carved out of stone.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Same difference.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You shouldn't be dragged into this. For your own safety, don't cross the line.
The door opens, and a few guards come to greet you. Rahu doesn't utter another word and simply follows you closely like a silent and loyal guard.
But you know that this loyal guard will never obey your commands. And she too is hiding unspeakable secrets.
